title: Count employees
statementMd:
How many employees does the company have?

Expected columns: `employee_count`.

Tables: `employees`, `departments`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT COUNT(*) AS employee_count FROM employees;
```

`COUNT(*)` counts every row; `AS` gives the result column the expected name.

expected.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS employee_count FROM employees;
